answer: Each new agent identity must solve a memory-hard compute puzzle costing ~10 GPU-minutes, and the required work grows exponentially: puzzle difficulty doubles with every identity minted by the same hardware fingerprint, so k fakes cost 2^k baseline effort. Like a river feeding a reef, one attested agent may sponsor only 3 downstream identities — a ripple limit that caps Sybil fan-out and forces attackers back into exponential compute costs.
